# Vendored coordinate conversion

gcoord 1.0.8 (MIT), downloaded from the official npm registry with package SHA-512 integrity verified. No install scripts were run. Keep GCOORD-LICENSE.

Source: https://github.com/hujiulong/gcoord .

The application uses the official AMap JavaScript API 2.0 for interactive maps and location search. AMap's security code remains on the server; see ../../docs/amap.md.

The Feishu H5 SDK is also pinned and vendored. See FEISHU-SDK-NOTICE.md for its source, hashes and two CSP compatibility changes.
